result.title: Paired Geometric Supervision for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
result.comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026 (poster). 37 pages including supplementary material; 8 figures, 22 tables
result.summary: We present OrthoPairGTL, a geometric training framework for cross-domain deepfake detection, built on a partially frozen DINOv3 backbone ($\sim$300M parameters), and make three contributions: (1) We re-evaluate six recent transfer-learning detectors (Forensics Adapter, Effort, three GenD variants and FakeSTormer) using the authors' released checkpoints under a single preprocessing pipeline across 17 cross-domain datasets (2018-2025), so that the reported gaps reflect method rather than per-method pipeline tuning. (2) We model the transformation between paired real and fake samples, training Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) adapters with an orthogonal pair decomposition, hyperspherical regularisation, and (in the GSD-LoRA variant) a set-level coherence objective. (3) Under LoRA, this regularisation gives a more stable optimisation profile: GSD-LoRA's post-peak validation degradation is $4.2\times$ shallower than plain LoRA at the same parameter footprint, and the time-averaged validation AUC across training is 1.82 pp higher. On the 17 datasets, GSD-LoRA matches or exceeds every re-evaluated baseline (92.82% vs. 91.58% for the strongest; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.015$, 13/17 per-dataset wins), with the largest gains on modern reenactment-heavy benchmarks (DSv1.1, DSv2). Under strict parameter budgets, LayerNorm-only tuning ($\approx$0.03% of the backbone) is the most stable configuration and matches the strongest baseline with a mean of 91.97%.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 OrthoPairGTL 几何训练框架，用真实-伪造配对样本的正交分解与超球正则化微调 PEFT 适配器，并在 17 个跨域数据集上重新评测六个 deepfake 检测器，以提升跨域检测泛化性。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是判别式伪造检测的监督与评测工作，没有涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据获取或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类决策，几何配对正则虽属表示约束线索，但与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
